title: Domain model version 2 rules
decision: Adopt the rules marked decided here in docs/05-domain-model/OUTPUT.md version 2: dispute once per entry within 30 days, closed by reversal, decline or withdrawal; one-time addition of goods lines; promised dates changeable with history; 30-day default promise; payment history calculation; limited-mode behavior; support access of at most 24 hours; 30-day shop deletion period
context: Rewritten for PRD version 2 after the change of direction (DEC-012, DEC-013). By founder instruction the agent decided open points without stopping; the founder reviews all six documents at the end.
rationale: Keeps the ledger immutable while allowing itemized detail and promised dates (EVID-017); most behavior rests on the founder's expectations (EVID-034); removal and the reliability indicator rest on an unverified reading of the personal data law (EVID-027)
